To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a method to efficiently measure two-dimensional velocity fields from distant, faint and low surface brightness galaxies.
a large fraction of galaxies at high redshift (z~0.5) exhibit irregular velocity fields, and that this is likely due to ongoing interaction processes.
a substantial fraction of distant galaxies have kinematically disturbed gas and that these disturbances are often caused by galaxy-galaxy or galaxy-cluster interaction processes.
